title: USDJPY M30 Asian Session & Volatility Calibration Test
research_question: Does enabling the Asian session (InpUseAsianSession=true) combined with volatility-calibrated SL/TP (InpMaxSLPips=20.0, InpTP1Pips=20.0, InpTP2Pips=40.0, InpTrailPips=10.0) and unthrottled lot sizing improve trade frequency, net profit, and drawdown stability on USDJPY M30 compared to baseline EXP-0030 across 2020-2024 training?
hypothesis: Because USDJPY experiences primary liquidity and directional trend initiation during the Asian/Tokyo market session, capturing Asian Fibonacci retracements with adequate pip room (20-pip SL) will prevent noise stop-outs and expand profitable opportunities, turning the -$849.34 loss of EXP-0030 into positive net profit while keeping maximal drawdown <= 8.0%.

facts: EXP-0030 on USDJPY M30 with London/NY-only sessions and 15-pip SL produced -$849.34 net profit, 0.34 profit factor, and breached the 8% total DD limit (8.72%).
EXP-0031 on USDJPY M30 in 2025 validation achieved +$280.24 and 74 trades when volatility surged.
USDJPY market participants transact highest domestic volume during the Tokyo session (00:00-08:00 server time).
On GBPUSD (EXP-0034) and EURUSD (EXP-0036), unthrottled lot sizing expanded net profit without increasing maximal drawdown.
inferences: Enabling Asian session trading allows the EA to enter high-probability Asian Fibonacci levels instead of only trading late-session European consolidation.
Expanding SL/TP to 20/40 pips accommodates JPY pip noise and volatility spikes.
Unthrottling lot sizing will allow full 1.0% risk payouts on winning Asian session setups.
evidence: EXP-0030 total_trades=31, profit_factor=0.34, win_rate=58.06%, total_net_profit=-849.34, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=8.72
EXP-0031 total_trades=74, profit_factor=1.16, win_rate=71.62%, total_net_profit=280.24, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=5.45

independent_variables.name: InpUseAsianSession
independent_variables.rationale: Capture Tokyo market session liquidity and primary trend moves on USDJPY.

independent_variables.name: InpMaxSLPips
independent_variables.rationale: Provide adequate buffer against JPY intraday volatility noise.

independent_variables.name: InpTP2Pips
independent_variables.rationale: Allow runner to capture larger 2:1 RRR trend continuation moves.

independent_variables.name: InpTrailPips
independent_variables.rationale: Prevent premature stop-out on runner trailing stop.

independent_variables.name: InpUseH4Soft
independent_variables.rationale: Disable H4 soft lot reduction to capture full 1.0% risk payoffs.

assumptions: Tokyo session trading produces clean Fibonacci reaction swings on USDJPY.
Drawdown guards (4% daily, 8% total) will protect capital if JPY volatility produces adverse streaks.
expected_observations: Total trades increase above baseline EXP-0030 (31 trades).
Total net profit turns positive (above baseline -$849.34).
falsification_conditions: Total net profit remains negative or profit factor remains < 1.0.
